additional_gate.cheapest_test: Run the pure-standard-library checker with --require-contrast over already reference-verified demonstration JSON or private episode JSONL. It needs no new Racket evaluation or model run.
additional_gate.possible_false_positive: A deliberately size-limited task or a valid lesson lacking an exact repeated shape can be rejected. Enable this gate only for the declared wall-context family contract.
additional_gate.reproducible_failure: The retained legacy seed-0 lessons admit a policy-aware size-only rival on all fourteen labels (28 protected intended/rival applications). The pre-refinement native lessons admit a boundary-only rival that rejects every three-cell L on all twelve labels checked (12 fresh candidate applications; intended labels reused from the retained protected audit). The current gate rejects both before states and accepts both release lessons, and the release audit refutes the shape rival on both core demos.
additional_gate.summary: Opt-in demonstration-only wall-context contrast gate: require a large painted region, a small interior rejected region with a failed complete bbox wall, and the same normalized small shape with opposite outcomes behind complete versus failed walls. It inspects no query labels or private policy metadata.

limits: Only release sampler/audit/export/qualification/causal artifacts support the current native source. Earlier artifacts, including intermediate -final files, are retained historical evidence and are not current qualification.
The 144 sampler requests use Python claims checked against an independent Python reference; they are not 144 native-qualified episodes.
The bounded seed and finite-rival checks establish the retained cases only; they do not prove universal identifiability, all-seed coverage or measured training benefit.
The final 260-file binding check is static; it performs no reference-program evaluations and grants no acceptance.
Causal intermediate descriptions are authored interpretations; final outputs are protected-Racket verified. No iterative-state or universal causal-depth claim is made.
The existing production battery was not rerun. Production source, canonical authority, approval and the audit index were not modified.
Owner acceptance was not performed and no training data was admitted.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-derived region partition and geometry. It determines both which complete rows/columns must be inspected and which actual cells can be painted.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Discover orthogonally connected black regions and derive each region's actual cell set, bounding box and complete side-wall facts from the current input.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Apply the episode's side-boundary policy plus the top/bottom walls and column-zero exception to each derived region, then paint only the cells of qualifying regions yellow.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Changing the region partition can merge a rejected L with a diagonal singleton, changing its bounding box, wall tests and later paint decision. Replacing actual membership by a filled bounding box can also paint gray cells. The policy alone does not identify the selected cells; this is a geometry-derived dependency, not iterative state simulation.

parametric_work.summary: Native adapter and source-bound promotion inventory are qualified for canvas_edges and gray_walls. The exact canonical default is retained. Input-derived four-connected component membership and bbox/wall facts determine later selection and painting; two protected wrong-intermediate witnesses were replayed. This is a geometry dependency, not iterative state simulation. Reviewer readiness is complete; fresh owner integration, qualification and acceptance remain required.

remaining_failures: The unchanged production generator retains the inherited generalized small-component shortcut and solid-top-row/distribution-cue audit findings. This native proposal does not clear those production audits.
report.summary: Built and qualified a native wall-context family with two side-boundary policies, independently variable 2–6 demos and 1–4 queries, constructive 8–30 grids, substantive 30×30 scenes, private native provenance and single-query actor exports. Fixed compact-scene repetition and a three-cell-L teaching shortcut. The first two demos refute all fourteen tested non-equivalent rivals. Current evidence includes 63 focused passing tests, 144 sampler requests, 594 protected audit evaluations, 60 native qualification evaluations and two replayed causal witnesses. Production audits remain open; owner acceptance is pending.
